# Hire prices - Thornreach Canal Boats

4-berth narrowboat, weekly: 1,180 pounds high season, 940 pounds low
season. A 150 pound security deposit is taken at booking and refunded
within five working days of return. Fuel is charged at the pump rate.

Day boats: 120 pounds per day, no deposit.
